shared_elements: low relief carving of figures against a plain ground
repeated animal figures arranged in a row/register
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in strict profile relief accompanied by anthropomorphic figures and organised by horizontal register lines, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. In A the animals are highly schematic, flattened and stacked one above another in vertical tiers with a splayed small figure, birds and a snake-like form, while B shows a naturalistically modelled two-humped camel led by a clothed, staff-bearing human in a horizontal procession framed by rosette borders — different creatures, different relationships (leading/handling versus isolated stacked animals) and quite different rendering conventions.
